item.satisfying_weapons.desc.unlock_crit: {FF5555}To unlock, combine with an identical weapon of any level using Upgrader!
item.satisfying_weapons.firework_sword.s: Hitting an entity grants 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}, up to 5_stacks. While in the air, press jump to consume 3_stacks of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} and do a {F29C2A}Firework Jump{AAAAAA}; then, sneak to do a plunge attack.
Plunge attack damage increases by 25% and is further increased by 15% for each entity in its current radius. Max damage increase is_100%.
For each entity damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}. Max 2_stacks per plunge attack.
For each entity damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_HP.
{ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} can now go up to 10_stacks. Also, {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} recovered from {EEEE66}Level_3{AAAAAA} is no longer limited to 2_stacks per plunge attack.
item.satisfying_weapons.toy_bow.skill_de: Shoots {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} that apply {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} to the target hit. While the target has an active {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA}, it will cause all non-friendly mobs to attack it.
Greatly increases accuracy and range of {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA}. Also, there is a 50%_chance to keep an arrow while shooting.

When {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} is applied, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} appears above the target’s head. After the {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} ends, or the target dies, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} will fall down and explode.
Entities with {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} are slowed down and receive 15%_more damage.

Hitting a {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} with a {1E90FF}Toy Arrow{AAAAAA} will cause it to explode and fire 5_identical {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} in random directions, prioritizing other mobs as targets.
item.satisfying_weapons.sword_of_dying_s: Right click to throw a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA}, which will continuously pull in surrounding entities for 1.5_seconds before disappearing. Costs 3_durability.
Durability cost is reduced to_1. Also, throwing a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} while sneaking will cause it to collect all items and experience into your inventory.
Entities affected by a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} will be inflicted with {6C3FE0}Entropy{AAAAAA}. Entities with {6C3FE0}Entropy{AAAAAA} receive 50%_more fall damage, and 20%_more overall damage.
Greatly decreases the cooldown for throwing {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA}. Entities affected by a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} now have a small chance to drop their equipment on the ground.
You can now ignore the cooldown for throwing {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA} at the cost of 4_HP. Colliding two {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA} creates a massive explosion, which doesn't damage the user.
advancement.satisfying_weapons.root.desc: Kill monsters, craft wishes, collect weapons
